newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 4.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Students set fire to cars and smash equipment at university in Ivory Coast's second town of Bouake over arrest of student militant; fresh student agitation disrupts classes at Abidjan's Cocody University
- Imams set up African Conference of Islamic Institutions at meeting in Ivory Coast; Ivorian El Hadj Diaby Moustapha named as its first head

- Ivorian Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan tells seminar on administration of public finances that African nations should aim for less state involvement in the economy and better management of sectors that the state retains under its control

- German Economic Cooperation Minister Carl-Dieter Spranger visits Ivory Coast; to examine progress on forestry protection, one of projects funded by Germany in the West African nation. - Ivory Coast's finance and savings sector to hold
government-sponsored open day at nation's main conference centre to explain their activities to the public from March 17-19.
- Workers at security firm Codival, which transports cash and valuables between banks and customers, threaten strike from Wednesday over working conditions and recognition of long service

- Students and teachers, who spoke on condition of anonymity, want examinations postponed following unrest in universities - Ivorian rubber planters set up new trade body; APHCI aims to represent planters' interests, improve standards and expand employment in the industry.
